patch.description: EPIC-17/G04 remains In Progress through admitted V01→V02→V03 and safe merge. Admission: docs/planning/EPIC-17-ADMISSION.md. V01 and V02 are Done; S459 accepts all seven recipes, 73 supported configurations and 146 front/back faces. Woven's 56 local faces pass the approved S457 front mask and local-Y back/band placement. S406's approved view-only collar-over-plackets order remains implemented. V03 is Blocked; no receiver/profile is selected or qualified. CLO 2026.1.310 empirical routes have measured geometry, marks and malformed-input failures; generic OpenCAD R14 is not an industrial apparel profile. The maintainer confirms written product-development/local-DXF permission and official GetonAgain Free desktop evaluation. GMS V2024.1 is user-authenticated but is a blank nesting workspace; its observed local Open route accepts Marker File (*.mkr), not DXF, and Output Auto CAD dxf is disabled without a marker. DGS V2023.1 Pattern Design & Grading did not expose a window on one launch. The official package specifies MPVCI 2.7 then its DGS upgrade. Rollback copies are recorded, but one MPVCI setup attempt left two live installer processes with no targetable window or completion/error state; the DGS archive was not applied. No fixture exchange occurred. Next: maintainer inspects the desktop and resolves the visible MPVCI installer state; after installation, apply DGS update and inspect local DXF dialogs without a fixture. Preserve V02-before-V03, legacy DXF behavior and protected export identities; preserve all-seven recipes/options/grades, fixed 0.001 cm geometry, identity/seams/marks, malformed-input rejection, repeatability, and rendered-output readability. No ANSI/AAMA or ASTM conformance, physical-fit, factory-acceptance or production-readiness claim. S657 packet: docs/research/epic17/S657-dgs-official-update/S657-exit-packet.md.
